edition.description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

rows.translation: We have surely given you [O Prophet] al-Kauthar [i.e., abundance][1],
rows.footnotes: [1] i.e., abundance, of which is the river of al-Kauthar in Paradise.

rows.translation: so pray and offer sacrifice to your Lord alone.
Indeed, the one who hates you is truly cut off [from all goodness][2].
rows.footnotes: [2] Both in this world and in the Hereafter.
